# Issue templates

`bug_report.md` asks for an exact version, environment and a minimal
non-sensitive reproduction. `feature_request.md` asks for a use case,
affected components and acceptance criteria. `config.yml` disables blank
issues.

Security reports follow [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md), not public issues.
Do not include credentials, invitation files, device identities, relay
addresses of real deployments or unrelated traffic.
